Note: Android does not allow non-admin apps to measure other devices\' data usage precisely. This app shows estimates based on local network activity and the ARP table, and shows this device\'s usage accurately via TrafficStats.

Important: Android does not allow regular apps to enforce real limits on other devices — this requires router privileges or root. Rules set here are managed from your router admin page (Parental Controls / Bandwidth Control / MAC Filter) or via a TM-Network-Manager compatible app (TMAC protocol, same as Fing).

PRIVACY POLICY — WiFi Network Scanner
Effective date: 2026-09-25
1) Data collection This app collects no personal data and requires no account. It has no servers and sends no information to the internet.
2) Displayed information The app shows information about your local network (device names, IP/MAC addresses, estimated data usage). All of it is read locally and stored only in the app private storage on your phone. It never leaves your device.
3) Permissions and why we need them - WiFi / Nearby devices / Location: to scan devices connected to your network (Android requirement). - Usage access stats: to display data usage. - Ignore battery optimizations & notifications: to keep scanning in background and alert you about unknown devices. - Internet: used only for future AdMob ads and update checks.
4) Ads The app may show ads via Google AdMob. Google may collect advertising identifiers per its policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
5) Your rights You can delete all stored data anytime from Settings → Reset statistics, or by uninstalling the app.
6) Children The app is not intended for children under 13 and does not collect their data.
7) Contact Privacy questions: ahmedtitio@gmail.com

TERMS OF USE — WiFi Network Scanner
1) Lawful use This tool is designed to help you manage YOUR OWN home network only. Misuse is prohibited, including: - Scanning or monitoring networks you are not authorized to administer. - Intercepting other people\'s data or spying. - Cutting off service to devices outside your authority.
2) Network ownership By using speed-control or blocking features you declare that you are the owner or an authorized administrator of the target router and network.
3) Limitation of liability - Scan results and usage estimates are approximate. - Blocking commands depend on router support; failure to execute is not an app defect. - The developer is not responsible for misuse of the app or any resulting damages.
4) Intellectual property All design and software rights are reserved to Ahmed Titio © 2026. Redistributing or selling the app without written permission is prohibited.
5) Changes Terms may be updated in new releases; continued use means acceptance.
